description:
4-5yrs with NodeJS 
 • Developer who has knowledge and experience developing web applications with Node.js, the core programming language for SONAR, and is familiar with how to remediate application security issues, particularly cross site scripting and SQL injection. Additionally, developers should have a working knowledge of AWS (Amazon Web Services), Elastic Beanstalk, application to database CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) queries, Talend job development, and Hapi, Inert, and Underscore JavaScript extensions and libraries. 
 • The team will work in a Scrum fashion, using Rally to facilitate project execution, and working with a Product Owner and Scrum Master. 
 • Additional stories and requirements will be added overtime, but current development objectives include, application security vulnerability remediation, improvement of database query performance, displaying additional information from the source database, user activity logging, application security hardening, improved metadata collection via Talend, enhanced searching functionality, IDM controlled group data editing, application filter SQL generation, and smart end user pass-through from SONAR to IDM. 


 
 
 If you are available, interested, planning to make a change, or know of a friend who might have the required qualifications and interest, please call me ASAP at  734-619-8931
